title: Air in wet surroundings
hook: An insulating layer need not be a thick pad of fat.

knows: Animals have structures and behaviors suited to particular conditions.
doesNotKnow: The pale circles stand for air held among dense hairs close to the skin. Sea otters groom fur that helps retain air for insulation in water. The picture is an enlarged schematic, not a measured cross-section.

misconception: A familiar animal behavior or structure must work in a different way.
objective: What can dense, groomed sea otter fur help hold near the skin?
